sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (₹5L–₹20L referenced in sub-limit table)

room_rent.note: Standard A/C room (single occupancy with attached washroom, excludes suite). Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken.

icu.note: ICU expenses paid at actuals with no stated cap.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay in base plan. Voluntary co-pay of 5%/10%/15%/20% available for premium discount. 20% co-pay applies on reimbursement claims if optional Cashless Discount cover is opted.

sub_limits.note: Inbuilt cataract sub-limit: 10% of SI per eye, max ₹50,000. Optional Procedure/Disease Sub-limit cover adds caps for cardiac, joints, hernia, calculi, hysterectomy, spine, cancer, kidney, liver, gall bladder, infections.

deductible.note: Voluntary aggregate deductible of ₹10,000–₹3,00,000 available as optional discount feature.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: 36 months continuous coverage required. Reducible via portability/migration credit.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Covers cataract, hernia, calculi, hysterectomy, organ transplant, arthroplasty, and 14 other listed conditions.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of base SI per claim-free year, max 100%. Reduces at same rate on claim. Optional Super Cumulative Bonus add-on offers up to 200% at 25%/yr or 100% at 50%/yr.

restoration.note: Sum Insured Reinstatement is an optional cover. Two options: once per policy year or unlimited times per policy year. Not available for organ donor or modern treatment claims. Subsequent hospitalisation must be after 2-day gap.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days after discharge.

day_care.note: Extensive indicative list of 399+ procedures provided; any procedure meeting day-care definition also covered.

domiciliary.note: Covered up to SI but excludes asthma, bronchitis, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, arthritis, vector-borne diseases, and several other conditions. Must exceed 3 days.

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation (min 24 hrs) covered up to In-patient SI. OPD and comfort/leisure treatments excluded.

organ_donor.note: Harvesting expenses for organ donor covered up to SI. Pre/post-hospitalisation of donor not covered. Restoration benefit not applicable.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered at reasonable & customary charges up to In-patient SI. Covers transfer to nearest hospital and inter-hospital transfer.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments including robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemo, intra-vitreal injections etc. covered up to SI. Cumulative Bonus and Restoration not applicable for this cover.

consumables.note: Non-medical items listed in Annexure II are excluded. Medical consumables used during treatment/surgery are covered as part of hospitalisation.

global_cover.note: Policy covers treatment within India only. Any medical treatment outside India is explicitly excluded.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim can be contested except for fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: 30 days for quarterly/half-yearly/annual premium; 15 days for monthly instalment mode.

free_look.note: Applicable at inception only, not on renewals or porting.

portability.note: IRDAI portability norms apply. Apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: No overseas treatment, domiciliary exclusions (diabetes, hypertension, asthma etc.), external congenital anomalies, growth hormone therapy, non-AYUSH/allopathy systems

optional_riders.display: Sum Insured Reinstatement (once/unlimited), Super Cumulative Bonus, Disease Sub-limits, Accidental Death Cover, Cashless Discount, No Claim Discount
